title: High Availability and Disaster Recovery Layer
summary: Maintain safe service continuity and recover governed platform state through tested, evidence-backed recovery procedures.

intent.statement: Protect authoritative platform state and recover critical services from defined failures without bypassing policy, security, integrity or evidence controls.
desired_outcomes: Critical components have owned RTO/RPO/recovery profiles.
Backup success is proven through restore validation.
Recovery restores truth/control services before normal writes and execution.

success_measures.name: Recovery profile coverage
success_measures.target: 100% production Tier 0–2 components have approved recovery profile and exercise evidence
success_measures.measurement_method: Launch review reconciles production component inventory with recovery profiles.

success_measures.name: Restore evidence
success_measures.target: 100% required backup classes have successful controlled restore evidence
success_measures.measurement_method: Recovery exercise reports and integrity validation.

provenance.rationale: Resilience must preserve governed platform truth.

problem.statement: Infrastructure restart or backup existence does not prove that AGASTYA can safely recover its control plane, authoritative data, ledger integrity, policy posture and resumable work after severe failure.
problem.current_state: Platform specifications define durable evidence and operational telemetry but no unified recovery-tier, backup, failover, integrity/reconciliation and exercise contract.
impact: Data or evidence could be unrecoverable/untrusted after failure.
Recovered runtimes might bypass policy or duplicate work.
Recovery objectives and responsibility could be undefined.

business_context.business_value: Evidence-backed recovery protects customer trust and makes service continuity measurable rather than assumed.

functional_requirements.title: Maintain recovery profiles
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a recovery profile for each production component/data class including tier, owner, dependencies, failure domains, RTO/RPO, backup method, restore runbook and exercise evidence.

functional_requirements.title: Protect and validate backups
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall produce encrypted, access-controlled, integrity-verified versioned backups or snapshots for authoritative data, object/evidence data, configuration and recovery metadata.

functional_requirements.title: Execute fenced recovery runbooks
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall provide authorised idempotent fenced runbooks for component recovery, failover, point-in-time restore, regional recovery and projection rebuild.

functional_requirements.title: Restore trust and integrity before writes
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall restore and verify identity/policy, Vault/key readiness, authoritative data, schema and Ledger integrity before enabling normal sensitive writes or privileged execution.

provenance.rationale: Recovery cannot bypass trust control plane.

functional_requirements.title: Reconcile durable work
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall reconcile durable task, queue, outbox, consumer, streaming and operation state after recovery using declared at-least-once semantics.

provenance.rationale: Resumable work must not claim exactly-once after failure.

functional_requirements.title: Test and evidence recovery
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall run and evidence scheduled recovery drills, restore tests, failover simulations and recovery acceptance suites.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Tier 0–2 RTO/RPO and recovery acceptance criteria shall be explicitly approved before production launch and actual objectives recorded for every exercise/event.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Launch/recovery review checks approved profiles and evidence reports.
non_functional_requirements.target: No Tier 0–2 production component without approved objective and evidence.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Recovery access, backup access and destructive restore/failover actions shall be least-privilege, purpose-bound, authorised and Ledger-audited.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Security recovery simulation verifies denial/approval/evidence paths.

business_rules.statement: A backup is not considered recoverable until its integrity and controlled restore have been verified and evidenced.

provenance.rationale: Backup completion is not restore proof.

business_rules.statement: Failover/restore must fence conflicting writers and use idempotent recovery identifiers; no simultaneous active writers may be enabled without declared consistency protocol.
When required policy, Vault, Ledger or authoritative data is unavailable, affected sensitive writes and privileged execution must deny/block with truthful degraded state.

constraints.statement: This draft makes no specific RTO/RPO or availability commitment and authorises no production backup, regional failover, traffic cutover or incident execution.
constraints.rationale: Objectives, topology and incident authority require approved risk/operations decisions.

dependencies.name: Deployment storage and backup/failover topology
dependencies.risk: Redundancy, fencing, restoration and recovery objectives depend on selected architecture.

bounded_contexts.name: Platform Resilience
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Own recovery profiles, runbooks, backup/restore validation, exercise governance and recovery evidence.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Approved component/data recovery objective and method record.
Authoritative state point selected for restoration.
Control preventing conflicting writers during failover/recovery.

workflows.name: Authorised recovery and validation
workflows.trigger: Declared component, data or regional recovery event.

steps.action: Authorises scope, runbook and recovery identifier; freezes conflicting writes as required.
Restores trust/control dependencies, authoritative data and ordered services.
Validates integrity, access, Ledger/outbox reconciliation and functional smoke before normal state.
steps.result: Recovered/degraded result and evidence are recorded.

outcomes: Authorised evidenced recovery without untrusted state transition.
workflows.error_handling: Validation failure remains degraded/blocked; no normal writes are enabled.

states.name: RECOVERED
states.description: Acceptance passed and normal operation authorised.

states.name: DEGRADED
states.description: Safe partial operation while dependency/recovery incomplete.

states.name: FAILED
states.description: Recovery validation failed; escalation/corrective action required.

security_requirements.statement: Recovery, backup and restore access shall be least-privilege, purpose-bound, approved and Ledger-audited, while required unavailable trust controls fail safe.
security_requirements.verification_method: Recovery security simulations cover unauthorised restore, conflicting writers and dependency loss.

observability_requirements.statement: Recovery state, backup/restore health, objective timing, validation and exercise outcomes shall emit correlated safe telemetry and Ledger evidence.
observability_requirements.verification_method: Exercise report reconstructs recovery lifecycle and objective outcome.

acceptance_criteria.title: Recovery profile is launch-ready
acceptance_criteria.then: Owner, dependencies, objectives, method, runbook and exercise evidence exist.

acceptance_criteria.title: Backup restores with evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: State passes integrity/access/functional checks and reports actual recovery point/time.

acceptance_criteria.title: Failover fences writers
acceptance_criteria.then: Conflicting writers are fenced and service state is truthful.

acceptance_criteria.title: Restore validates control plane
acceptance_criteria.then: Schema, Ledger, trust and outbox checks complete before normal writes.

acceptance_criteria.title: Control dependency loss fails safe
acceptance_criteria.then: System blocks/denies and emits degraded evidence.

acceptance_criteria.title: Interrupted work reconciles
acceptance_criteria.given: Agent tool or stream work is interrupted.
acceptance_criteria.then: Work reconciles under at-least-once semantics with evidence.

acceptance_criteria.title: Exercise produces corrective evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: Evidence reports objective, checks, gaps and corrective links.

test_requirements.scope: Recovery profile and exercise evidence review.
Encrypted backup controlled restore, integrity and control-plane validation.
Failover fencing and truthful service-state transitions.

risks.title: Untested recovery or split-brain corrupts control/data truth
risks.description: Recovery could restore incomplete state, permit conflicting writes or bypass security if untested.
risks.mitigation: Fenced runbooks, restore validation, fail-safe control dependencies, exercise evidence and architecture ADR.

open_questions.question: What RTO/RPO availability and recovery-tier objectives apply to initial service/data classes?
open_questions.impact_if_unresolved: Production resilience objectives cannot be committed.
open_questions.resolution: Accepted as a detailed-design risk. Tier-specific RTO/RPO and availability objectives require approved business-risk policy before production launch.

open_questions.question: Which storage database queue and deployment topology provides required redundancy backup restore and fencing?
open_questions.impact_if_unresolved: HA/DR implementation architecture cannot be selected.
open_questions.resolution: Accepted as a detailed-design risk. Storage, queue and deployment topology ADR is mandatory before implementation.

architecture_decisions.title: Use tiered recovery profiles and evidence-backed ordered recovery
architecture_decisions.context: AGASTYA control/data services have different failure impact, and recovery must not bypass governance or corrupt durable state.
architecture_decisions.decision: Classify services/data by tier, require approved recovery profiles, restore trust/control/data in order, fence failover writers, reconcile durable work and evidence every exercise/recovery.

alternatives.name: Uniform restart-based recovery
alternatives.summary: Treat all services/data as stateless restartable components.
alternatives.rejection_reason: Cannot protect authoritative data, policy, Ledger integrity or resumable work.

architecture_decisions.rationale: Tiered measured recovery preserves availability goals without sacrificing engineering truth/security.
consequences: RTO/RPO and topology decisions are mandatory before production.

provenance.rationale: Recovery must validate Ledger integrity and evidence before normal writes.

coverage_summary.method: Initial HA/DR draft mapping; implementation coverage is not yet applicable.

change_history.reason: Define resilience and recovery control before selecting production topology/objectives.

change_history.reason: The Project Sponsor approved the tiered evidence-backed recovery model.
